products.name: INFINITY®
products.description: Polystyrene foam core between two extra-rigid sheets of digital-grade polystyrene. Can be printed, shipped flat, then cold bent into 3D displays.
benefits: 2.5x density foam (vs. competing products, per site)
UV stabilized (UV-resistant package applies to 50" and narrower sizes only)
Cuts ~30% quicker on digital cutters such as Zünd
100% recyclable (3mm cited as recyclable EPVA alternative)

sizes.note: 3mm listed as 3mm x 48" x 192". Sell sheet: custom sizes available.

products.colorNote: Site: 'All configurations of Black and White; 3mm available in White'. Sell sheet: core White and Black, liner White and Black.

resources.label: Look What INFINITY Can Do for You

notes: Exact color configurations beyond 'all configurations of black and white' are not enumerated on the site; the four core/face combinations are inferred from the sell sheet (core White/Black, liner White/Black).

products.name: EAGLECELL®
products.description: Recyclable all-paper honeycomb graphics board: proprietary honeycomb paper core (95% open space) with triple-thick bright white clay-coated liners. Eco alternative to plastic, metal and wood.
benefits: Honeycomb core with 95% open space – lightweight
I-beam-like strength, rigidity and warp resistance
Kraft core bonded to SFI-certified surface papers

gauges.listedSource: Product page min/max; 1/2" shown in gallery (Beach Chairs, Artisan Oil Display)

sizes.note: Sell sheet: width 24–60", length 24–144", custom sizes available.

notes: Conflicts: product page min gauge 1/4"; sell sheet says min 3/16" (Natural only). Master brochure (Rev 1/5/23) says 1/2"–4" and 48"x96"–60"x120". App uses the product page.

products.name: InSite® Reveal® HA
products.description: Extruded polystyrene core with clay-coated liners; one side has a neutral-pH heat-activated adhesive. Ready to use – no mounting tissues or films.
benefits: No mounting tissues or films needed
For mechanical or hot vacuum presses and heated roll laminators
notes: Page text says it bonds at '165°F-70°F' – looks like a typo (likely 165–170°F); verify before quoting.
SDS list includes a separate 'Heat Activated Low Temp' SDS – product not otherwise described.

products.name: InSite® Self-Adhesive
products.description: Reveal® memory foam center faced one side with clay-coated paper and the other with a Low-Tack or High-Tack cold pressure-sensitive adhesive under a release liner.
benefits: No heat required – roller, squeegee, cold vacuum frame or cold laminator
Low-Tack is repositionable (green liner); High-Tack grabs immediately (black liner)

resources.label: SDS – InSite Self Adhesive LT and HT

products.name: InSite® Acid-Free
products.description: Polystyrene foam core between two acid-free paper liners for preservation mounting and framing.
benefits: Liner pH 7.5–9.5, buffered with 3–5% calcium carbonate
100% high alpha cellulose virgin pulp liners

products.name: MountCor®
products.description: Heat-activated board with the lowest bonding temperature (130°F / 54°C) per Gilman; neutral-pH permanent adhesive, translucent gridded release liner, air-release technology, acid-free.
idealFor: Waterborne, solvent, UV and latex inkjet
products.colorNote: Spec block says White; body text and brochure say white or black.

products.name: MountCor® Canvas
products.tagline: Permanent HA Board for Printed Textiles
products.description: HA board developed for mounting digitally printed canvases and fine-art giclées that cannot be stretched; bonds at 130°F (54°C), full tear strength in ~4 minutes in a vacuum press.
benefits: Bonds all canvas grades/weights (11–24 mil), coated/uncoated/metallic

products.name: Resilient® PRINT™

products.description: Velvety smooth closed-cell foam board with a consistent white surface for direct digital printing; velvet black core edge needs no treatment. Patent pending.
